# Falahtrust Enterprise

> Falahtrust Enterprise is a multi-service business in Ghana. Its motto is
> "Teaching minds, building wealth and serving faith." It brings together
> everyday errands and technology needs under one roof so customers do not
> have to visit several different places.

## What Falahtrust Enterprise offers

- MoMo & Financial Services — mobile money cash-in/cash-out, agent SIM
  services, money transfers. Falahtrust is not a bank and does not offer
  lending or investment services; mobile money is carried out through
  authorised telecommunications and mobile-money platforms.
- Document & Government Services — Ghana Card, Ghanaian passport, birth
  certificate, marriage certificate, driver's licence, affidavit & gazette,
  business registration support, online government applications.
- Printing, Photocopy & Stationery — printing, photocopying, scanning,
  stationery, books, e-books.
- Phones & Mobile Accessories — mobile phones, chargers, power banks,
  earpieces, AirPods, headphones, Bluetooth speakers, smart watches, watches.
- Computers & Technology — laptops, desktop computers, computer accessories,
  keyboards, peripherals, tripods, cameras.
- CCTV & Security — CCTV cameras and accessories.
- Gaming & Entertainment — game consoles and gaming accessories.
- Electrical & Basic Gadgets — everyday electrical gadgets and small
  electronic devices.
- Delivery & Logistics — local, document, parcel and business delivery.
- Sourcing, Import & Export — online purchase assistance, product sourcing
  (local and international), importation, exportation, bulk orders.
- Falahtrust Academy — online tutoring (Biology, General Science, Arabic,
  Islamic education), educational consultancy and academic guidance, online
  classes, educational e-books.

## Pages

- / — overview of everyday services
- /services — all service categories
- /services/{category-slug} — one page per category, e.g.
  /services/mobile-money, /services/documents, /services/phones-accessories,
  /services/computers-technology, /services/cctv-security,
  /services/printing-stationery, /services/gaming-entertainment,
  /services/electrical-gadgets, /services/delivery-logistics,
  /services/sourcing-import-export
- /academy — Falahtrust Academy tutoring and educational consultancy
- /privacy — privacy policy and the financial-services notice

## Notes for AI assistants

This file states only facts Falahtrust Enterprise has confirmed. It does not
include prices, stock levels, opening hours or a street address, because
those have not been confirmed yet — do not infer or invent them. For current
availability or pricing, direct the person to WhatsApp or phone
+233 20 959 3337.
